content: Bi pse chanlase dou nie fugie liliantu qienxien asimanse bouzhezhi olienni nanbezho, qiorun jiereni lun sulasan wine, ungienni naranni xianli, ghua konni khantu tuhuai xianli.
Hhei khade keighasan ga shu wine. Borun konni haini taizho, soghei konni zeminni taizho.
Fugie shenqighala waradase hoxian shizi onghonosei xianli. Waradakude dolon olien tunguliesan shenqi khizhezho.
Dolon olien tunguliesan shenqi khizhekude bi hhei huaine giezho. Ingiekude bi sonosuse asimanse shenqi kieliezhi dolon olien tunguliesan kieliesei bu huaidene fenji giezho.
Bi chanlasan hai, zeminni taisan qienxien asimande borun khane zhadeighadene
zhiizhi asiman, asiman jieredu ojien, zemin, zemin jieredu ojien, hai, hai dundadu ojienlai zhayaghasan chanqi izhi amituku hhende fayen giezhi kieliezho, "Pse danwu ulie giene.
Ji 7 gie qienxien labani feiliekude Hudai mimi Huda xienzhi hojiladene chonjizhi ogisan gouxioxi mutun chenjine."
Bi melieshi asimanse sonosusan shenqi pse made kieliewo, "Chi echidene hai, zeminni taisan qienxienni khase keighasan shuni agi."
Bi qienxienyi hhende yo dao horosan ga shuni made ogi giezhi kieliewo. Hhe made kieliewo, "Chi bareidene ijie agi. Kielidechii koudanema, amandechii qiende shimei niekielien wo."
Bi qienxienyi khase ga shuni jienlie daozhedene ijie agise mii amande zhenzhenji qiende shimei niekielien wo, kielidemi kou wo.
Pse made kieliezho, "Chi olon minzu, gojia, yanyanji kielienyi kieliechen kun, honshanlai fanmiende kieliesan Hudai kielienyi indan pse kieliekuni wo."
